Data Structures and Algorithms

This module serves as a foundational pillar for your journey into software engineering, data science, and artificial intelligence. You will develop a deep understanding of how data is organised, processed, and optimised through the use of appropriate data structures and algorithmic strategies.

Learning Objectives for this module:

+  Demonstrate an understanding of common data structures, algorithms and derive time and space complexity measures.

+  Be able to solve a problem algorithmically, and present logical and coherent written/verbal arguments for choices made in relation to data structures and algorithms.

+  Understand how to code and evaluate data structures and algorithms for efficiency.
